@fatihozer90 Could you share the pcap for this case? To upload pcap file, you need to compress pcap file as below.

$ tar zcvf a.tar.gz your.pcap

Then, you can upload the compressed file.

Thanks a lot!
Sukchan

@acetcom, You can find pcap file below. In Frame 35, NRF sends FIN message.

[a.tar.gz](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/files/5748852/a.tar.gz)

@fatihozer90 

That assertion is what I forcefully fired. Unfortunately, that doesn't happen with open5gs NFs. The way to avoid it in Open5GS's NRF is simple, but it would be nice to make sure there are any other problems with your NF.

@fatihozer90 

There was a bug in receiving large HTTP2 messages on Open5GS. I've updated the patch in the main branch.

Thanks a lot!
Sukchan

You are linking to the old libcurl which do not support http2, check it with the command as below:
[root@localhost bin]# ldd open5gs-amfd | grep curl
	libcurl.so.4 => /usr/local/lib/libcurl.so.4 (0x00007f7651e28000)

With curl you need to specify : curl --http2-prior-knowledge "\<uri\>" -v, to force having HTTP/2 header
